reviews.text:
I like it… but it’s rough. Reward me for focus? Say no more. This is a brilliant way to gamify your productivity and I was so excited to put this to work.
But… there’s 2 issues with this that make me uninterested in going premium or even keeping it on my phone.

1) you’re able to set up different goals you’re working towards. A few of mine are “chores”, “exercise”, “self care”. When you train, you pick your goal and the skill you’re training with it. I like this idea because it tracks the time set towards each goal. Ideally, you can review these numbers every few days or weekly and determine where you might want to spend some more time.
2 star rating because when I’m doing my focus, the app often switches the goal I’ve actually selected to the first one on the list. My goal numbers are wildly inaccurate as a result with over 19 hours in one goal area and less than 4 hours in every other one.
If I was only using the app for focus and not for balance, this wouldn’t be an issue. But not being able to consistently track which goal I’m committing to is a huge fail in my book and it makes your time data useless

2) I was able to adventure when I first downloaded the app. And that’s it. If you don’t get premium, this app is nothing but a timer. I don’t know why they let me explore the adventure tab and bird/pet shops for about 30 hours before putting them behind a permanent paywall… but I’ve never seen those screens since.
I could be enticed to check them out… but the existing glitchiness of the app really turns me off from rewarding them with my money.

To get 5 stars on my review:
- fix the “set goal” in the focus tab to not reset. OR let me edit the times I’ve spent on tasks later so they properly reflect where my time was spent 
- be clear about paywalls or don’t tease us. I spent a few minutes in adventure, realized I needed my stats up, and then never got to see the adventure screen again.

I love the idea for this app but it’s kind of busted right now imo

One of the coolest features is the detailed statistics it provides about how much time you spend on your phone. It’s both eye-opening and motivating seeing those numbers encourages me to stay focused and use my time more intentionally.

What makes Focus Hero even more special is the adorable little pet you get along your journey! As you stick to your goals and challenges, your pet grows and evolves, which is super cute and rewarding. It’s like having a companion cheering you on while you build better habits.

The app also offers unique challenges and customizable armor upgrades that make staying on track feel like a game. Whether you’re battling distractions or working towards goals, these features keep you motivated and make productivity more exciting.

If you’re looking for a fun, effective way to cut screen time, stay focused, and achieve your goals, Focus Hero is the perfect app. Download it you won’t regret it!

You make a list like chores, relax, tasks, dnd, outside work, errands, ect. Then you choose what you are doing that day and for how long. It doesn’t push you around like other apps do either. I get 1 notification a day and that’s it. Where I swear some apps send multiple. So again I know I’m still new on the app I actually am quite impressed and feel like I’m staying on track with my ADHD.

I honestly really like this!. I have a few criticisms and suggestions about this app but overall I really like it and I do find it helpful. Usually when I pick up an app that claims to help with adhd by making lists or giving you motivation I just don’t find them motivating. I like that I can record what I’m doing and get a prize for it, I like the cute art and I like customizing the hero. My few suggestions would be… the subscription doesn’t really feel worth it, due to the only thing you receive is the pets and expanded adventure mode, but I’m sure the features will be expanded. I don’t like that the pets are locked behind a paywall, but that’s just because I absolutely can’t afford it and I have a lot of coins I want to use. My second suggestion is adding a daily log in reward, such as coins, or a level upgrade in a certain category like defense. My third suggestion is that with the skills, really cool feature, but when it comes to the hero customization there’s not much you can get unless you work on defense and meditation, and the others don’t play as big of a part. I would like if they did play a bigger part! 

Genuinely this app has helped me out a lot it gives me something fun to think about and do once I’m done with my tasks for the day, and so far I’ve been using it every day and I’m enjoying it! 

:) thank you developers!!

I really like it so far!. I’ve had this app for a few days, and I’ve fiddled with it a bit but only really started using it today. 

I like it! I feel like it could be a little more clear on instructions for the gameplay itself- the task focus part is very well explained, but for example, I can’t seem to figure out what the coins are for. However if I can remember to use the app when I go to start a task, I find it’s a pretty cool motivator and I’m also invested in the story 😂

Also, I love that it has a timer, but I think it would be cool to have a “to-do list” feature instead of being limited to general actions. Even if it was a set amount of focus reward per item on the list or based on how long it took. Like, 1 focus for each 2-5 min a task took to complete. 

As a person with ADHD, I find general or vague tasks to be overwhelming. I have basically no sense of priorities, just anxiety. So if I have “home care” on my task list as an overall title for chores like dishes, cleaning, laundry, etc- I still have to make myself a list and actually make myself do it. And this is WITH medication. So being able to assign a to do list to a task (ex- task: home care. Items: do dishes, sweep floor, empty trash, dust.) and then to receive a small reward for every item crossed off, and then the completion reward at the end of the time. It also gives you a countdown which helps motivate you to complete everything in that time frame- maybe a bonus if you finish all of the tasks required? Maybe that’s too complicated, but that would be a cool (maybe optional?) feature for those who would like to do it!
